The ones I can reach the fastest right now are...
the kitties at the park!

This realization came precisely because I rushed to meet them at top speed.
It was a fruitful cat patrol. ...So, Trainer, what brings you here?

*sigh* If only I could huff you kitties...
Alas, we have not yet established sufficient trust...

Ehehe... Oh, that reminds me, Light O-chan.
Have you met the cat stationmaster at the nearby station? So delightfully plump, just like a mochi daifuku~.

Left with no other choice, I hailed a taxi to speed over
to the cat cafe in the neighboring town to chase after her――

Haaaaaaaaaaah!
Wait for me, kittiiiiiiiies!!!!
HAH!!!!
Applause.
This straight-line showdown is miiiiiiine!!

Trainer pedestrian safety, checked. Zero collision accidents, checked.
Pardon the disturbance.
In that case! I must go find a kitty that will let me huff them!

Fastest means top speed. In other words, no one can catch up.
Waiting here was a sound tactical judgment on your part.

Unable to keep up with Calstone Light O, I waited at the school gate for several hours.
At last, she returned.

Whew... haah... L-Light O~! I wasn't finished spea—
*cough*! That cat cafe... is closed today~~~...!

...However, I will not be discouraged. I will not falter. I will not surrender.
The shortest path to encountering a kitty is not here.

UOOOOOOOOOHHH!!
Trainer ahead!! Look out!!

If you drop an item, it is almost impossible to recover.
Because I am fast—far too fast—

I will not let you, giant beast!
I shall be the first to meet the feline stationmaster!
(Plop)

I hurry because there is a reason to hurry.
Excuse me.
, I nearly slipped up again.

Allow me to tell you an invigorating tale.
It is about kitties. You must inhale the essence of kitty stories.

The next bus to the station with the feline stationmaster is... What? In one hour?!
What a waste of time! I can simply run there!
That is... the bus that departed earlier!

Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow! Oof... bunny-kicking with its hind legs.
However, this in itself is adorable, so it is fine. Thank you.

So cute, so cute, so cute, so cute!
There, there, good kitty, purr-purr-purr-purr!

Oh, Trainer. Today you somewhat resemble
either a zombie or dried seaweed before rehydration.
(SCREEEEEEEECH!!)
...Dammit!!

Calstone Light O acts so fast that no one can catch up with her.
Will the day ever come when I can move at the same speed as her—

...No, this is too cruel. What an awful turn of events.
To think that even with maximum speed, I cannot meet the kitties...!

Apparently, she went off to the cat cafe without knowing it was closed today.
I try calling her, but can't get through at all.

We use the word 'kitty' broadly, yet no two kitties are identical.
Each is different and each is wonderful, but all are undeniably kitties.

Cat, cat, cat, c-c-cat.
...A hymn praising kitties. A masterpiece, if I do say so myself.
